scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix Oncomap/backend --prefix Oncomap/backend && npm && npm install --prefix Oncomap/frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "FRONT,BACK" -c "green,blue" "npm run dev --prefix Oncomap/frontend" "npm run dev --prefix Oncomap/backend"
scripts.docker: cd Oncomap && sudo docker-compose down --volumes --remove-orphans && sudo docker-compose up --build
